package student

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

type practiceTaskCourseContentStub struct {
	lessons map[string]*answeruc.LessonMetadata
}

func (s practiceTaskCourseContentStub) GetLesson(_ context.Context, lessonID string) (*answeruc.LessonMetadata, error) {
	lesson, ok := s.lessons[lessonID]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := *lesson
	return &copy, nil
}

func (s practiceTaskCourseContentStub) GetCourseStructure(context.Context, string) (*answeruc.CourseStructure, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func TestOrderPracticeTaskPartLessonsUsesSingleOrderedSequence(t *testing.T) {
	useCase := StudentUseCase{
		CourseContent: practiceTaskCourseContentStub{
			lessons: map[string]*answeruc.LessonMetadata{
				"lesson-1": {ID: "lesson-1", CourseID: "course-1", Order: 1},
				"lesson-4": {ID: "lesson-4", CourseID: "course-1", Order: 4},
				"lesson-6": {ID: "lesson-6", CourseID: "course-1", Order: 6},
				"lesson-7": {ID: "lesson-7", CourseID: "course-1", Order: 7},
			},
		},
	}
	current := &partRuntimeContext{
		runtimeContext: &domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{
			MilestoneSkillTags: []domain.MilestoneKindSkillTag{
				{MilestoneKindCode: "practice-task-finish", SkillTagCode: "lesson-6"},
				{MilestoneKindCode: "practice-task-finish", SkillTagCode: "lesson-7"},
				{MilestoneKindCode: "practice-task-start", SkillTagCode: "lesson-1"},
				{MilestoneKindCode: "practice-task-start", SkillTagCode: "lesson-4"},
			},
			LessonSkillTags: []domain.LessonSkillTag{
				{LessonID: "lesson-1", SkillTagCode: "lesson-1"},
				{LessonID: "lesson-4", SkillTagCode: "lesson-4"},
				{LessonID: "lesson-6", SkillTagCode: "lesson-6"},
				{LessonID: "lesson-7", SkillTagCode: "lesson-7"},
			},
		},
		partMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
			{ID: "milestone-finish", MilestoneKindCode: "practice-task-finish", SortOrder: 2},
			{ID: "milestone-start", MilestoneKindCode: "practice-task-start", SortOrder: 1},
		},
		completedLessonIDs: map[string]struct{}{},
	}

	lessons, err := useCase.orderPracticeTaskPartLessons(context.Background(), current)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}

	got := make([]string, 0, len(lessons))
	for _, lesson := range lessons {
		got = append(got, lesson.ID)
	}
	want := []string{"lesson-1", "lesson-4", "lesson-6", "lesson-7"}
	if len(got) != len(want) {
		t.Fatalf("expected lessons %v, got %v", want, got)
	}
	for index := range want {
		if got[index] != want[index] {
			t.Fatalf("expected lessons %v, got %v", want, got)
		}
	}
}

func TestOrderPracticeTaskPartLessonsUsesExplicitVariantRouteOrder(t *testing.T) {
	useCase := StudentUseCase{
		CourseContent: practiceTaskCourseContentStub{lessons: map[string]*answeruc.LessonMetadata{
			"lesson-html": {ID: "lesson-html", CourseID: "course-html", Order: 100},
			"lesson-css":  {ID: "lesson-css", CourseID: "course-css", Order: 1},
		}},
	}
	current := &partRuntimeContext{
		runtimeContext: &domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{},
		partMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{{
			ID:        "milestone",
			SortOrder: 1,
			LessonBindings: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding{
				{LessonID: "lesson-html", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired, SortOrder: 10},
				{LessonID: "lesson-css", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired, SortOrder: 20},
			},
		}},
		completedLessonIDs: map[string]struct{}{},
	}

	lessons, err := useCase.orderPracticeTaskPartLessons(context.Background(), current)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("order explicit route: %v", err)
	}
	if len(lessons) != 2 || lessons[0].ID != "lesson-html" || lessons[1].ID != "lesson-css" {
		t.Fatalf("expected authored route order, got %#v", lessons)
	}
}

func TestExplicitLessonPrerequisitesOnlyBlockRequiredUnits(t *testing.T) {
	alternativeGroup := "html-alternative"
	bindings := []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding{
		{LessonID: "required", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired, SortOrder: 10},
		{LessonID: "alternative-a", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired, AlternativeGroup: &alternativeGroup, SortOrder: 20},
		{LessonID: "alternative-b", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired, AlternativeGroup: &alternativeGroup, SortOrder: 30},
		{LessonID: "recommended", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRecommended, SortOrder: 40},
		{LessonID: "optional", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementOptional, SortOrder: 50},
	}

	prerequisites := resolveExplicitLessonPrerequisites(bindings, map[string]struct{}{"alternative-b": {}})
	if len(prerequisites.UnmetLessonIDs) != 1 || prerequisites.UnmetLessonIDs[0] != "required" {
		t.Fatalf("expected only standalone required lesson to block, got %#v", prerequisites)
	}
	if len(prerequisites.RecommendedLessonIDs) != 1 || prerequisites.RecommendedLessonIDs[0] != "recommended" {
		t.Fatalf("expected recommended lesson metadata, got %#v", prerequisites)
	}
	if len(prerequisites.OptionalLessonIDs) != 1 || prerequisites.OptionalLessonIDs[0] != "optional" {
		t.Fatalf("expected optional lesson metadata, got %#v", prerequisites)
	}
	if !prerequisites.UsesExplicitRoute {
		t.Fatal("expected explicit route marker")
	}
}

func TestRecommendedLessonDoesNotBlockLaterRouteLesson(t *testing.T) {
	milestones := []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{{
		LessonBindings: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding{
			{LessonID: "recommended", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRecommended},
		},
	}}
	if !practiceTaskRouteRequirementSatisfied(milestones, "recommended", map[string]struct{}{}) {
		t.Fatal("recommended lesson must not block the route")
	}
}

func TestLessonsInSamePrerequisiteGroupCanBeOpenedInAnyOrder(t *testing.T) {
	group := "layout-stage"
	milestones := []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{{
		LessonBindings: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding{
			{LessonID: "lesson-a", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired, PrerequisiteGroup: &group},
			{LessonID: "lesson-b", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired, PrerequisiteGroup: &group},
		},
	}}
	if !practiceTaskLessonsSharePrerequisiteGroup(milestones, "lesson-a", "lesson-b") {
		t.Fatal("lessons in one prerequisite group should not block each other")
	}
}

func TestExplicitLessonBindingRejectsCourseMismatch(t *testing.T) {
	useCase := StudentUseCase{CourseContent: practiceTaskCourseContentStub{lessons: map[string]*answeruc.LessonMetadata{
		"lesson": {ID: "lesson", CourseID: "actual-course"},
	}}}
	_, err := useCase.loadPracticeTaskBoundLessonsInOrder(context.Background(), []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding{{
		LessonID: "lesson",
		CourseID: "declared-course",
	}})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected course mismatch validation error")
	}
}
